findings.issue: Furigana attribute is not the orthographic kana reading of the enclosed text: ケーキ is rendered as けえき (katakana flattened to hiragana and the chōonpu ー written as え). The correct orthographic reading keeps the katakana word, as the rest of the course does (e.g. 'コーヒーをのむ' for コーヒーを飲む).

findings.issue: Furigana attribute renders the katakana loanword ケーキ as けえき. The orthographic kana reading of a long vowel in a katakana word is ケーキ (or けーき with the chōonpu), never けえき.
